registry.toolSchemaDesc: Infer a schema from JSON, validate against a schema with precise error paths, generate samples, explain structure

schema.schemaPh: Paste a JSON Schema, or infer one first and hit “Use inferred”
schema.notSchema: The schema must be a JSON object.
schema.subsetNote: A subset of keywords is supported: type/enum/const/nullable, properties/required/additionalProperties, items/minItems/maxItems/uniqueItems, minLength/maxLength/pattern/format, minimum/maximum/exclusive*/multipleOf, allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, local $ref. Remote $ref and if/then/else are not supported.
schema.err_additionalItems: {path}: extra items are not allowed here.
schema.err_minLength: {path}: length must be at least {min}, got {actual}.
schema.err_maxLength: {path}: length must be at most {max}, got {actual}.
schema.err_badPattern: {path}: the pattern in the schema is invalid: {pattern}.
schema.err_oneOf: {path}: must match exactly one branch, matched {matched} of {count}.
schema.err_not: {path}: matched a rule it must not match.

agent.toolSchemaInfer: Infer a JSON Schema from JSON
